title: Grateful Dead Live at Woodstock Music on 1969-08-16
lineage: Panasonic SV-3700 > Cardas cable S/PDIF > Edirol UA-5 > analog out > Korg MR-1 DFF @ [1bit/2.8 mhz] Rate Conversion: AudioGate to [24bit/96 khz] Mastering: In WaveLab with L3 Waves Multimaximizer Rate Conversion with r8brain to [16bit/44.1 khz] > TLH > Flac

ai_review.summary: Decent audience recording of Woodstock with a monster 45‑minute Pigpen “Turn On Your Lovelight”, sound needs EQ but is listenable.
ai_review.review: The August 16 1969 Bethel set captures the historic vibe of Woodstock, highlighted by an epic 45‑minute Turn On Your Lovelight that shows the band in solid form. The recording is an audience tape that benefits from EQ adjustments; it isn’t pristine but remains enjoyable for fans. Overall sentiment is mixed – one reviewer finds it worthwhile while another dismisses it.

ai_rating.rationale: Show receives moderate praise (3‑star review) with a standout Pigpen jam, but recording quality is only described as needing EQ and no clear soundboard source, pulling the combined rating down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Older audience tape that sounds a bit muddy; reviewers recommend using EQ to improve clarity. No major drop‑outs noted but overall fidelity is limited.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set pacing; the review focuses mainly on the long Pigpen jam and general atmosphere.
